name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingCell.program_meets
theorem_title: Construction of one retained shared reporting catalog cell
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k$ be natural parameters with $k\le J$. Two integer subset functions on width $464hJ$ have stored source stages through cutoff $2hJ$, bounded by $B,D$. Suppose actual pointer cells identify those stages before a five-cell metadata record, the record precedes payload, and box cutoff satisfies both suffix-width and prefix-cardinality restrictions. Assume the stated payload-finish, scalar, power, key, index, value-word, address, and pair/query/sort depth bounds. The closed program returns the exact next-free address, builds the complete catalog entry with threshold $t$, retains both source-stage families, and preserves earlier memory except the five metadata cells within its stated time.

Creates one first-class stored catalog in the shared bank. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
explanation: Creates one first-class stored catalog in the shared bank. The computed entry includes the exact metadata, sorted index, pointer array, and suffix boxes for one source pair and depth.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceBandHost.Procs.meets
natural_language_statement:
Let two stored integer arrays of lengths $N_L,N_R$ be bounded by $U$, with positive band width $g$, prime control $p$, cutoff at most $464hJ$, and stored shift bounded by $D$. Suppose their actual length and band-count headers, selected-cover maps, candidate indices, and histograms are correct and precede the output base. Under the concrete host interface and stated space, word, address, and depth bounds, the routine constructs both original-source catalogs and all occurrence banks, returns the exact finish address, and preserves the input prefix within its stated time.

Shares original-band histograms across every selected occurrence vector. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
explanation: Shares original-band histograms across every selected occurrence vector. The host constructs the original residue catalogs once, then builds occurrence-indexed source banks while preserving earlier inputs.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingStoredStep.program_meets
theorem_title: One reporting level from persistent physical headers
natural_language_statement:
Let $k<J$, finite integer source sets, and a wanted label satisfying its exact membership and shifted lifted-key condition be given. Suppose memory contains the correct source families, next-depth catalog and metadata, next packed output row, and current complete frontier with its actual capacity. Assume the catalog bounds and query-scratch contracts, metadata and row ends before root storage, output-frontier separation from ordered child scratch, the stated scalar-space and depth bounds, and address representability. The closed stored-step program constructs the exact depth-$k+1$ frontier, returns its length, and preserves all earlier frontier slots within its stated time.

Advances the actual persistent traversal using stored counts and pointers. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
explanation: Advances the actual persistent traversal using stored counts and pointers. The next frontier is built from the stored previous header and actual next output row, with earlier frontier slots preserved.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.program_meets
theorem_title: Building all prescribed shared reporting levels
natural_language_statement:
Let two bounded integer functions on subsets of width $464hJ$ have stored stages through cutoff $2hJ$, identified by actual pointer cells. Let $K$ be at most terminal depth plus one. Suppose the $5K$ metadata slab precedes payload, all source data and pointers precede metadata, addresses fit words, and the complete per-level resource contract holds at the current depth. The closed program builds all $K$ reporting levels in its stated time, returns the exact next payload address, preserves memory before metadata, and changes earlier payload-prefix cells only within that metadata slab.

Constructs the complete reusable level family for one source pair. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
explanation: Constructs the complete reusable level family for one source pair. The loop writes all prescribed metadata records and payload catalogs while retaining both source-stage families throughout.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceControlsHost.Procs.meets
theorem_title: Complete retained source controls and occurrence banks
natural_language_statement:
Let two original arrays be bounded by $U$, with correct length and band-count headers, positive $g,p$, cutoff at most $464hJ$, stored shift bounded by $D$, and exact selected-cover input. Suppose all original arrays, headers, maps, candidate indices, and histograms precede the output base. Under the concrete control-host interface and its stated allocation, word, address, and depth bounds, the routine writes the exact source-control record, constructs both original-band catalogs and shared occurrence banks, and returns the exact finish address in its stated time, preserving every earlier cell.

Combines the computed source dimensions and their actual retained data in one callable contract. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
explanation: Combines the computed source dimensions and their actual retained data in one callable contract. The returned control record names the exact constructed pair catalog and occurrence banks, so later selectors can use actual stored pointers.
